[Story]
Xiao Ming and Xiao Gang are good friends, they walk home together every day. They notice that Xiao Guang, who just moves in, takes the same route. One day, they see Xiao Guang walking alone ahead, Xiao Ming gives Xiao Gang a look, then chuckles. They quicken their pace, walk up to Xiao Guang, and start to talk to him. At first, Xiao Guang just smiles in response to their words. But gradually, he starts to join their conversation, they walk home together.

[Question]
Why does Xiao Ming chuckle at Xiao Gang?

[Candidate Answers]
A. Xiao Ming finds something Xiao Gang says earlier is interesting.
B. Xiao Ming chuckles at Xiao Gang, indicating he wants to play a joke on Xiao Guang.
C. Xiao Ming finds it somewhat funny that Xiao Guang walks alone.
D. Xiao Ming chuckles at Xiao Gang, indicating they can try to make friends with Xiao Guang.
